museumDatasetCrossCheck.descriptionScope: The resource metadata describes common and commercial Philippine fish collection samples gathered at landing sites and markets of commercial ports and nearby seas.

queries.purpose: Holotype catalog-number lookup within this dataset

museumDatasetCrossCheck.interpretation: Neither bounded query found an indexed row in this dataset. This does not establish that PNM 15678 is absent from the physical collection or from non-indexed records. The dataset's stated scope also does not show that it is the type-series catalog.

interpretation: The official catalog directly reports a 2024 species description and a Cagayan River/Muta type locality, providing a traceable historical taxonomic lead for the Cagayan drainage candidate.
The catalog reports one holotype and 15 paratypes across PNM and SEAFDEC; those lots were not independently checked against collection labels or records.

A published National Museum fish-collection resource under ASEAN Centre for Biodiversity reports 8,225 records and CC-BY 4.0, but bounded GBIF queries found no exact-name or holotype-number row in that resource; this is not evidence that the physical type lot is absent.
Textual drainage agreement does not supply coordinates, an exact river reach, current presence, abundance, or distribution throughout the B0380 basin.
The GBIF strict-name and Philippines occurrence searches returned no match/records in the checked responses; this is not evidence of species absence.

sources.supports: Directly retrieved Catalog of Fishes species treatment: accepted name, Endruweit 2024 page/figures, Cagayan River/Muta type locality, reported holotype and paratypes, drainage and habitat.

sourcePolicy.rightsReview: No item-specific reuse terms for the original book, catalog content, or underlying specimen records were verified.
sourcePolicy.qualityReview: Historical type-locality evidence alone does not establish current fish presence, catchability, legal status, or safety.
